role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 在战场间飘行的同时献祭小兵，为自己的袭击补充魔法，巫妖随时可以操控减速的冰霜帮助队友消灭他们的敌人。对于蠢到聚在一起的敌人，他极富弹跳性的终极技能将确保他们的灭亡。
hero_summary_en: Drifting from battle to battle and sacrificing creeps to fuel his assaults, Lich is always ready to help his fellow heroes destroy their enemies with slowing frost. Should his foes be foolish enough to gather, his bouncing ultimate will ensure their demise.

abilities.name: lich_frost_nova
abilities.description_zh: 破坏性的寒霜在目标敌方单位身上爆发，造成范围伤害并降低范围内敌人的移动和攻击速度，持续%abilityduration%秒。主要目标所受伤害最高。
abilities.description_en: Blasts the target enemy unit with damaging frost, dealing area damage and slowing movement and attack rates for %abilityduration% seconds.  The primary target receives both base and area damage.

abilities.name: lich_frost_shield
abilities.description_zh: 施加一个冰霜魔盾环绕目标，减少受到的普通攻击伤害。魔盾生效时，每%interval%秒都会对附近的敌方单位放出冰霜魔法，造成少量伤害和减速。
abilities.description_en: Applies a magical frost shield around the target, reducing damage from attacks against it. While the shield is active, ice magic will affect nearby enemy units every %interval% seconds, dealing minor damage and slowing them.
notes_zh: 免疫技能的敌人不会受到伤害或减速。
冰霜魔盾可以对友方建筑施放。
notes_en: Spell-immune enemies are not affected by the damage or slow.
Frost Shield can be cast on buildings.
facet_text_en: Whenever an enemy dies under the effect of Frost Shield, its duration is increased.
facet_text_zh: 每当敌人死于冰霜魔盾的效果下，技能的持续时间都会增加。

abilities.name: lich_sinister_gaze
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 使一个敌方单位着魔，缓慢走到巫妖与其之间的一点，并吸取其当前魔法值的一定百分比。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Hypnotizes an enemy unit, causing it to move towards a point between the two of you and drains a percentage of its current mana.

scepter_loc.en: Sinister Gaze becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of %aoe_scepter% in the target area. Sinister Gaze allows Lich to cast other abilities while channeling it.
scepter_loc.zh: 阴邪凝视变成范围型技能，对目标区域%aoe_scepter%范围内所有单位生效。在阴邪凝视的持续施法期间可以施放其他技能。

abilities.name: lich_ice_spire
abilities.description_zh: 在目标地点创造一根寒冰尖柱，减缓范围内敌人的移动速度。可以承受%max_hero_attacks%次英雄攻击或%max_creep_attacks%次非英雄攻击，并且被摧毁时会在附近产生一个寒霜爆发的效果。连环霜冻可以对尖柱施放，并且范围内没有其他敌人时可以弹跳至冰柱上，同时对尖柱造成1点英雄攻击。巫妖可以对其施放冰霜魔盾。冰霜魔盾每次造成伤害时会治疗尖柱，使其回复1次英雄攻击次数。
abilities.description_en: Creates an Ice Spire at the target spot, slowing enemies around it. Can take %max_hero_attacks% hero hits or %max_creep_attacks% creep hits and when destroyed it will create a Frost Blast around it.Chain Frost can be cast on the Spire and can bounce to the Spire and damage the spire by 1 hero attack if there are no other enemies in range.Lich can cast Frost Shield on the Spire. Each Frost Shield tick will heal the spire by 1 hero attack.

abilities.name: lich_death_charge
abilities.description_zh: 牺牲一个友方非英雄单位，把它的当前生命值转化为巫妖的魔法，并且巫妖获得它的击杀经验。游戏开始时处于冷却，没有能量点数。
abilities.description_en: Sacrifice an allied creep to convert its current health into mana for Lich and give Lich its experience bounty.Begins the game on cooldown and with no charges.
notes_zh: 无法牺牲远古或类英雄单位。
被牺牲的非英雄单位记为反补，会对敌方英雄提供经验。巫妖获得的击杀经验和敌方英雄获得的反补经验为分开计算。
notes_en: Sacrificed creeps count as denies and can give experience to enemy heroes. Lich's experience bounty and enemy heroes' deny experience are independent.

abilities.name: lich_chain_frost
abilities.description_zh: 释放一个在敌人间弹跳至多%jumps%次的霜冻之球，每次击中敌人后都会造成伤害和减速效果。每次弹跳后会提升后续的伤害。连环霜冻无法弹跳时会停留在上个目标身上，如果出现新目标可以再次弹跳。
abilities.description_en: Releases an orb of frost that bounces between nearby enemy units up to %jumps% times, slowing and damaging each time it hits. Each bounce increases the damage for the subsequent bounces. Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
notes_zh: 连环霜冻的移动速度为%projectile_speed%。
连环霜冻不会弹跳到墓碑召唤的僵尸身上。
notes_en: Chain Frost has a movement speed of %projectile_speed%.
Chain Frost doesn't bounce to Zombies.
facet_text_en: Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
Killing an enemy with Chain Frost increases the number of bounces.
facet_text_zh: 连环霜冻无法弹跳时会停留在上个目标身上，如果出现新目标可以再次弹跳。
连环霜冻击杀敌人后会增加弹跳次数。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_lich_6
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_radius} Frost Blast Radius and Area Damage
